SO2_Anomaly.limitations: Satellite SO2 is a column amount, not direct ground-level concentration.

SO2_Anomaly_Percent.use_case: Relative sulfur dioxide increase comparison across regions
SO2_Anomaly_Percent.limitations: Unstable when baseline SO2 is near zero.

SO2_Zscore.threshold: Z >= 2 indicates anomaly; Z >= 3 indicates high anomaly
SO2_Zscore.limitations: Requires reliable baseline period and quality filtering.

SO2_Hotspot.limitations: False positives may occur from volcanic plume, transport from other regions, retrieval noise, or cloud contamination.

SO2_Exceedance_Ratio.use_case: Compare observed SO2 against a health or regulatory standard
SO2_Exceedance_Ratio.limitations: Use only when ground-level SO2 concentration or modeled near-surface SO2 is available.

SO2_ppb_to_ug_m3.use_case: Convert SO2 ppb to microgram per cubic meter at 25 C and 1 atm

SO2_ug_m3_to_ppb.use_case: Convert SO2 microgram per cubic meter to ppb at 25 C and 1 atm

Sulfur_Pollution_Index.limitations: This is a risk index, not a direct concentration measurement.

Stagnation_Index.formula: if wind_speed < 1 then 1.0; else if wind_speed >= 1 and wind_speed < 3 then 0.6; else 0.2
Stagnation_Index.use_case: Air stagnation risk term for Sulfur Pollution Index
Stagnation_Index.limitations: Low wind supports accumulation risk but does not identify pollutant source.

Plume_Direction_Analysis.use_case: Estimate sulfur plume movement and likely downwind impact direction
Plume_Direction_Analysis.limitations: Requires time-matched meteorology and careful source attribution.
